title: Lights — Ceiling and Wall Wash Lighting — Electronic Ballast and Prismatic Diffuser Retrofit

ata.title: Passenger Compartment Lighting — Ceiling and Wall Wash Lights

abstract: Retrofit of the high-frequency electronic ballast and the prismatic diffuser for the fluorescent ceiling and wall wash lighting, offered to operators who were not ready to move to solid state lighting.

sections.planning_reason: Cabin crew and passengers report visible flicker in the ceiling and wall wash lighting at the dimmed setting used during boarding, and tube life is running at about 4000 flight hours against a nominal 9000. The magnetic ballast fitted at build runs the tube at line frequency, which is close enough to the flicker fusion threshold to be seen at low output, and its starting characteristic blackens the tube ends. One operator logged 52 cabin defect reports against the lighting in a single year across 34 aircraft.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin replaces the magnetic ballast with a high-frequency electronic unit housed in the existing stowage envelope and fits a prismatic diffuser that widens the wall wash pattern and hides the tube outline. The ballast mounting bolts are replaced by a shorter grip because the electronic unit is thinner.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Isolate the cabin lighting circuit and lower the ceiling panels in zones 265, 271 and 291. Remove the tubes and set them aside on a padded surface. Remove the magnetic ballast from the stowage envelope D3320117509271. Install the electronic ballast and secure it with the shear head bolts LN983579-8C in the shorter grip. Re-drill the curtain rail sub-assembly D3320000585452 where the new diffuser clip lands. Install the prismatic diffuser and re-fit the tubes. Restore the ceiling panels and the dimming input at the lighting panel FIN 51RH. Do the lighting functional test at full, dimmed and night settings and confirm that no flicker is visible at the dimmed setting. Record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to ZEPHYR-18, ZEPHYR-20, ZEPHYR-22 and ZEPHYR-24 classic aircraft not yet at the solid state lighting standard. It has no effect on aircraft already converted to solid state lighting, which have no fluorescent tubes and no ballast. Operators are advised to convert a full cabin zone at a time because the colour temperature differs slightly from the magnetic standard.
sections.material_note: Kit K3320-1088-01 contains the ballasts, the diffusers and the bolt set for one aircraft. Lead time is nine weeks. Removed ballasts are not returned. The kit is being run down as operators move to the solid state standard and no further production is planned.
